title: Impact of Antibiotic Treatment of Group A Streptococcal Blistering Distal Dactylitis in Children
brief_summary: Single-center prospective study to assess the clinical course of group A streptococcal blistering distal dactylitis in children after antibiotic treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children 0-18 years
* Distal blistering dactylitis collected or not collected
* Positive rapid Group A Streptococcus test
* Informed consent signed by the parents

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subungual or pulp Whitlow
* Children not affiliated to the social security scheme
* Refusal by the parents to participate in the study
